UnitStatement: The export profile builds the public `chirality-app` repository from the private canonical `chirality` tree.
The public export excludes private projects, domains, migration records, historical plans, source corpora, archives, dependency folders, build outputs, local runtime state, and environment files.
The export script is run from the private repo root.
The standard export command is `python3 exports/chirality-app/export_public.py`.
The README instructs reviewers to review the staging report before replacing the local public repo.
The command `python3 exports/chirality-app/export_public.py --apply-target /Users/ryan/ai-env/projects/chirality-app` applies the export to the local public repo.
